name: Pizzeria Pejani
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Pejani in Zirl** serves up authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Tirol. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, their wood-fired pizzas are baked to perfection. Pair your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz** or a refreshing **Radler**, and enjoy the cozy atmosphere in this charming village near **Innsbruck**. Don’t miss their homemade **Tiramisu**—a sweet finish to any dinner! Open daily, this spot is perfect for families, friends, or a romantic evening. Just a short drive from **Tirol’s** stunning landscapes, it’s the ideal stop for food lovers exploring the region.
